questions.question: What is the function of the blower in a two-stroke diesel engine?

options.a: To pump out the exhaust gases from the cylinder
options.b: To supply pressured air to the cylinder to burn the residual fuel
options.c: To supply pressured air to the cylinder to remove fuel fumes
options.d: To supply "fresh" pressured air to the cylinder to remove gases

questions.question: What can happen when the valves' clearance is too large?

options.a: Noisy operation and decrease in output
options.b: Loss of compression and heating of the engine
options.c: Faster burning and increase in output

questions.question: What can insufficient small valves clearance cause?

options.a: Faster burning
options.b: Noisy operation
options.c: Burning of the exhaust valve

questions.question: What closes the suction openings in a two-stroke petrol engine?

options.a: The piston
options.b: The valve
options.c: The cylinder

questions.question: What is the main function of the crankshaft counterweight?

options.a: Centrifugal balancing force
options.b: Weight increase of the crankshaft
options.c: Balancing force to the combustion pressure

questions.question: What characterizes the fuel tubes from the injection pump to the spray-nozzles?

options.a: Straight and tight
options.b: Smooth in order to prevent pressure fall
options.c: They have same length

questions.question: What is the function of the fuel injector?

options.a: To spray the oil into the fuel (mixture)
options.b: To spray the returned fuel
options.c: To spray the fuel into the injection pump
options.d: To spray the fuel into the combustion chamber

questions.question: What will be the impact on the engine structure as the number of cylinders increase?

options.a: There is no impact due the number of cylinders, only the weight
options.b: The fly-wheel will become smaller proportionally to the number of cylinders
options.c: The fly-wheel will grow proportionally to the number of cylinders
options.d: The number of pistons will decrease proportionally

questions.question: What is the main characteristic of a diesel engine?

options.a: An internal combustion engine and ignition by compression
options.b: An internal combustion engine and ignition by spark
options.c: An external combustion engine and ignition by compression
options.d: An external combustion engine of diesel

questions.question: What is required prior to engine start-up?

options.a: Cleaning and oiling of gear systems
options.b: Connection to power and transmissions check-up
options.c: Set systems off and check up of liquids
options.d: Check for leaks and that the bearings are in order

questions.question: What is required after start-up?

options.a: Check oil pressure and sea water disposal

questions.question: What are the functions of the piston rings?

options.a: Sealing the clearance between the piston and the cylinder
options.b: Stopping the piston movement prior to the end
options.c: Preventing the widening of piston
options.d: Regulation of the piston wear and tear

options.a: Inertia preservation and rpm maintenance between strokes in the operation cycle

options.c: Providing momentum to the gear box
options.d: Maintaining regulated turning of the propeller

options.b: Turning linear movement to rotational movement
options.c: Acceleration of the pistons movement
options.d: Stopping the fast movement of the pistons

questions.question: How is pressured lubrication (oiling) performed?

options.a: By the hydrostatic pressure of the oil
options.b: By the oil pressure pump
options.c: By the gravitational force of the oil

options.a: Suction, combustion, compression, exhaust
options.b: Compression, Combustion, suction, exhaust
options.c: Combustion, suction, compression, exhaust

questions.question: Which mechanism performs (times) the valves operation?

options.a: The camshaft
options.b: The fly-wheel
options.c: The crankshaft

questions.question: What are the pistons and connecting rods in the engine connected to?

options.a: To the crankshaft
options.b: Directly to the shaft
options.c: To the camshaft
options.d: To the fly-wheel through the connecting rod

questions.question: How is the speed of the engine revolutions in a diesel engine adjusted?

options.a: By controlling the revolutions regulator
options.b: By the feeding pump
options.c: By controlling the air regulator

questions.question: Which cog-wheel does not turn during regular engine operation?

options.a: That of the timing shaft
options.b: That of the starter
options.c: That of the braking system

options.a: The injection pump
options.b: The distributor

questions.question: In which area of the engine is the oil pressure measured?

options.a: In the oil suction line
options.b: After the oil filter
options.c: In the oil sump

questions.question: What is the function of the piston?

options.a: To seal the cylinder space
options.b: To start the valves
options.c: To turn the burning pressure to linear movement

questions.question: How is the fuel ignited in a diesel engine?

options.a: By the heat created due the compression of air
options.b: By an electric spark
options.c: By the heat created from the piston friction with the cylinder's side walls

questions.question: What is the function of the connecting rod?

options.a: To restrain the pistons' shaking
options.b: To connect the piston with the crankshaft
options.c: To shake the camshaft

options.a: Diesel drops with air
options.b: Air with fuel fumes (mixture)
options.c: Fuel fumes only

options.a: By stopping the fuel flow with the revolutions regulator
options.b: By disconnecting the electric power to the feeding pump
options.c: By disconnecting the air flow
options.d: By disconnecting the pumping system by mechanic command

questions.question: Where is the oil in a diesel engine concentrated?

options.a: In the oil sump
options.b: In the pump and the piping system
options.c: In the upper absorption tank

questions.question: What is the main function of the air blower in a two-stroke diesel engine?

options.a: To deliver more air into the cylinder in order increase the engine output
options.b: To fully utilize the temperature of the exhaust gases
options.c: To increase the engine's speed
options.d: To compress fresh air to the cylinder instead of the suction activity occurring in a four-stroke engine

questions.question: What is the function of the turbo charger in a four-stroke diesel engine?

options.a: Reduction of the injected fuel amount and thus meaningful saving in fuel consumption
options.b: Increase of the engine's output
options.c: Increase of engine's revolutions speed by compressed air pressure into the cylinders

questions.question: On what does the output change in a diesel engine depend on?

options.a: The injection pressure
options.b: The type of injected fuel
options.c: The amount of injected fuel

questions.question: What is the basic purpose of the centrifugal pump in the engine?

options.a: Spiraling of the fuel
options.b: Injecting oil

questions.question: What is the function of the injection pump?

options.a: Providing fuel under pressure and timing to the spray-nozzles

questions.question: What is the operation principle of the piston's pump?

options.a: Volume change

options.c: Pressure change

options.a: Switch-off, low output, high output

questions.question: What is the operating principle of the centrifugal pump?

options.a: The centrifugal speed turns to rotational movement
options.b: The liquid is thrown to the pump's center due to the rotational movement
options.c: The liquid is thrown to the pump's side walls due to the rotational movement
options.d: The centrifugal speed turns to force

questions.question: What is the common use of the immersion pump?

options.a: Pumping of fresh water
options.b: Pumping immersed oil
options.c: Pumping fuel from the bottom of the tank in emergency
options.d: Pumping bilge water in an emergency

questions.question: What is the common feeding pump in the engine's fuel system?

options.a: Diaphragmatic pump
options.b: Rotor pump
options.c: Impellor pump

questions.question: On what principle does the rubber impellor pump (Jabsco) operate?

options.a: Pressure change
options.b: Speed change
options.c: Volume change

questions.question: What can be the cause that the bilge centrifugal pump cannot dispose the water to the sea?

options.a: The centrifugal resistance is too low
options.b: The hydrostatic pressure at the exhaust is too low
options.c: The centrifugal load is too high

questions.question: In a closed system, what is the function of the fresh (treated) water pump in the engine's cooling system?

options.a: To cool the sea water
options.b: To cool the oil
options.c: To bring the water back from the expansion tank
options.d: To transfer by the water the engine's heat in the heat exchange to the sea water

options.a: To spiral the water to cool the oil
options.b: To supply water to cool the freshwater system
options.c: To flow water to cool the incoming fuel
options.d: To supply water to directly cool the engine top
